title: 第4章 教室
content_zh:
见到自己的初级治疗水竟然有这两大功效，展飞脸上也是露出了一丝满意之色，不过这个时候，展飞感觉脸上一凉，接着展飞便看到，刘元用一只筷子搭在了自己的额头上面，并且开口道：“老三，你刚才做什么美梦了？怎么脸上的表情这么淫荡？”

展飞听了，愣了一下，才道：“知道我做的美梦，还打扰我？”

刘元听了，道：“别做白日梦了，大中午的，饭带回来了，吃饭吧！”

刘元是这个寝室的老大，年龄最大，而且在展飞等人之中，也是最有理想有抱负的一个，他也是整个寝室里面学习最好的一个，像是展飞、郭鑫以及周泰这种人，每个学期末考试都能够过，完全都是靠着刘元帮忙啊。

所以说，刘元对于展飞等人来说，可以说是冬天里的一把火，黑夜之中的天灯，给他们照亮了前进的路。

没有刘元，展飞等人的重修费都不知道要交多少呢，故而在这个四人寝室里面，刘元这个老大的位置，无可动摇，所有人都是叫的心服口服，而展飞听到了刘元的话，这才感觉到，貌似自己也确实饿了，所以他也是从床上爬了起来，道：“辛苦老大了，这是小费。”

展飞说着，递给了刘元一张一百的，刘元也是拍了一下展飞的肩膀，把钱收了过去，别误会，展飞一顿饭可吃不了一百块，刘元每天给展飞等人带饭，而每次都是满一百块结算一次，从上次结算到现在已经四天了，又满了一百块了，所以展飞才会给刘元一张一百的。

而随即，展飞便和寝室里面的三个哥们儿一起吃饭了，至于自己脑海之中的角色面板，待会儿再好好研究一下，寝室里面的人大多数时间都是自己玩自己的游戏，也就是吃饭和睡觉的时候有点交流，今天也是一样。

古人的食不言寝不语在这里却是恰恰相反的，只听刘元开口道：“今天下午第一节课是黑面的课，待会儿可早点做好准备！”

黑面是展飞等人的一个导师，名为黑面，自然人长的很黑了，而且还很狠，每节课都要点名，而且曾经放下话来，他的课，只要点名两次没到的，期末考试一律挂科！

这种老师展飞等人可惹不起，故而一到这位的课，他们寝室就得全体出动了，当然了，也仅仅是充个人头而已，展飞等人去了基本上也是玩玩手机，要么干脆睡觉，黑面对此倒是不会管，这也是他的规矩。

在他看来，只要人到了，就是给了他黑面面子了，至于做什么，黑面从来不管，不影响其他人就好，毕竟不爱学就是不爱学，就算黑面能够强迫他们抬头看着黑板，但是也不可能让他们脑袋里面也都想着和自己教授的课程有关的事情啊？

而且这也不是初中高中了，黑面管一个出勤率，已经是展飞老师们里面最为严厉的一个了，很多老师是来了就讲课，讲完课就走人，台下有一个学生或者一百个学生和他根本没有关系···

因为下午要去上黑面的课，接下来展飞也没有时间研究附体到自己身上的那个游戏角色了，而是去洗手间洗脸刷牙，然后穿上衣服，时间已经一点多了，下午两点上课，展飞又稍微等待了一会儿周泰和郭鑫，然后便上课去了，至于老大刘元，早就去教室自习了。

展飞等一行人到了的时候，班上已经有十多个人了，在教室的最后面，一男一女坐在一起，展飞等人眼中都是不约而同的闪过了一道羡慕嫉妒恨，那对男女，男的，是展飞等人隔壁寝的一个家伙，名为陆丰。

能够在这个狼多肉少的校园泡到妞，陆丰的本事肯定不凡了，或者说，是本钱不凡，这家伙是展飞他们班上的副班长，同时在学生会也任职，也算是一个风云人物了。

而他的家庭条件也极为不错，父亲开了一个小企业，母亲则是博州理工的一名教授，加上陆丰本人也算是长得高大帅气了，所以是展飞等人班上为数不多的非单身人士。

而展飞等人进来，也没有引起大家的惊讶，展飞他们系有两个班，普通的课，两个班五十多人只有二十来人上课，但是上黑面的课，次次都是满员，即便来了几个生面孔，也不会有人惊讶的，那是有人找的替课的。

此刻，教室里面的黄金位置，最后几排，已经被人给占据了，所以展飞和周泰几人也是无奈，只能坐到比较靠前的位置了，展飞等人坐下来之后，系里的其他同学也是陆陆续续的到了。

一些比较好学的学生们占据了前排，中间的席位也是渐渐的被填充了起来，原本缺席率高达百分之六十的教室竟然差不多被坐满了，而也在即将上课的时候，三名女生姗姗来迟了，而班上不少人的目光都是暗暗放在了刚刚进入教室的这三名女生身上。

三人为首那人，上身是一件黑红相间的短袖，露出了雪白的双臂，下身则是牛仔短裤，修长纤细的双腿暴露在空气之中，一头干练的中长发，搭配上精致的五官，大大的眼睛，手里提这一本解析几何的书，口里含着一根棒棒糖，活像是漫画之中跳出来的人物。

这个人，正是展飞等人这个系的系花韩菱了，在韩菱的身后，则是她的两个好姐妹，看上去柔柔弱弱我见犹怜的王雪菲，还有身材丰满但是带着一丝富态的许娇容，王雪菲论起姿色，不比韩菱差。

只不过，因为性格比较内向，所以王雪菲在班级的人气，却要略逊韩菱一筹的，而三女看到班级里面满满的人头之时，眼中也是露出了一丝意外之色，接着，许娇容似乎想起了什么，小声道：“今天是黑面的课，那些不太常见的家伙也来了。”

许娇容说着，用眼神扫了一下展飞等这批人，此刻教室里面的座位已经比较少了，三人巡视了一番，许娇容和王雪菲两人无奈，坐到了陆丰和他女朋友的一侧，陆丰和他女朋友两人坐的是四列的座位。

不过大多数人不想当电灯泡，当然了，更多的是不想让自己更加的羡慕嫉妒恨，所以没有去打扰她们，许娇容两人也是没有座位了，才坐了过去，而剩下的韩菱，也是大大方方的坐到了展飞的一侧。

虽然教室里面还有其他好几个空座，不过这些空座都是在里面，只有展飞等三人，都是靠墙坐着，所以空位是在外面的，眼睁睁的看着韩菱坐到了自己的一侧，展飞的心跳都是发生了一丝变化，然后才恢复过来。
content_en:
Seeing that his primary healing water had these two major effects, Zhan Fei also showed a trace of satisfaction on his face. However, at this time, Zhan Fei felt a chill on his face. Then Zhan Fei saw Liu Yuan put a chopstick on his forehead, and said: "Lao San, what dream did you have just now? Why did you have such a lustful expression on your face?"

Zhan Fei was stunned for a moment after hearing this, and then said: "You know the sweet dream I have, and you still disturb me?"

After hearing this, Liu Yuan said: "Stop daydreaming. It's noon. I brought the rice back. Let's eat!"

Liu Yuan is the boss of this dormitory, the oldest, and among Zhan Fei and others, he is also the most ideal and ambitious one. He is also the best student in the dormitory. People like Zhan Fei, Guo Xin and Zhou Tai can pass the final exam every semester, all because of Liu Yuan's help.

Therefore, Liu Yuan can be said to be a fire in winter for Zhan Fei and others, and a sky lantern in the dark night, lighting up their way forward.

Without Liu Yuan, Zhan Fei and others would not know how much they would have to pay for the renovation. Therefore, in this four-person dormitory, Liu Yuan's position as the boss was unshakable. Everyone was convinced. When Zhan Fei heard Liu Yuan's words, he felt that he was indeed hungry, so he got up from the bed and said, "Thank you for your hard work, boss. This is a tip."

Zhan Fei said and handed Liu Yuan a hundred yuan. Liu Yuan also patted Zhan Fei's shoulder and took the money. Don't get me wrong, Zhan Fei can't afford a hundred yuan for a meal. Liu Yuan brings meals to Zhan Fei and others every day, and every time he settles the bill when it reaches a hundred yuan. It has been four days since the last settlement and it has reached another hundred yuan, so Zhan Fei will give Liu Yuan a hundred yuan.

Immediately, Zhan Fei had dinner with his three buddies in the dormitory. As for the character panel in his mind, he would study it carefully later. People in the dormitory spent most of their time playing their own games, which meant they had some communication while eating and sleeping. It was the same today.

The ancient people's habit of saying nothing during eating and sleeping was exactly the opposite here. Liu Yuan was heard to say: "The first class this afternoon is a black-faced class. Please get ready early!"

Hei Mian is a tutor of Zhan Fei and others. His name is Hei Mian. He is naturally very dark and ruthless. He has to take roll call in every class. He once said that anyone who fails to show up for his class twice will fail the final exam!

Zhan Fei and others can't afford to offend this kind of teacher, so as soon as they arrive at his class, they all have to go out to the dormitory. Of course, it's just for headcount. Zhan Fei and others basically play with their mobile phones or simply sleep. Blackface doesn't care about this. This is also his rule.

In his opinion, as long as people arrive, they are giving him black face. As for what he does, Hei Mian never cares, as long as it does not affect other people. After all, if you don't like to learn, you don't like to learn. Even if Hei Mian can force them to look up at the blackboard, it is impossible for them to think about things related to the courses he teaches?

And this is not a junior high school or high school anymore. The black-faced one is responsible for attendance, and he is already the most strict one among Zhanfei’s teachers. Many teachers give lectures as soon as they come and leave after the lecture. There is one student or a hundred students in the audience that has nothing to do with him...

Because he had to attend a black-faced class in the afternoon, Zhan Fei did not have time to study the game character that possessed him. Instead, he went to the bathroom to wash his face and brush his teeth, and then put on his clothes. It was already past one o'clock, and class started at two o'clock in the afternoon. Zhan Fei waited for Zhou Tai and Guo Xin for a while, and then went to class. As for the eldest brother, Liu Yuan, he had already gone to the classroom to study on his own.

When Zhan Fei and others arrived, there were already more than ten people in the class. At the back of the classroom, a man and a woman sat together. Zhan Fei and others all had a flash of envy and jealousy in their eyes. The man and woman were a guy named Lu Feng who slept next door to Zhan Fei and others.

To be able to pick up girls on this campus where there are more wolves than meat, Lu Feng must have extraordinary abilities, or in other words, extraordinary capital. This guy is the deputy monitor of Zhan Fei's class, and he also serves in the student union, so he is considered a man of influence.

And his family conditions are also very good. His father runs a small business, and his mother is a professor at Bozhou Polytechnic. In addition, Lu Feng himself is tall and handsome, so he is one of the few non-single people in Zhanfei and others' class.

When Zhan Fei and others came in, no one was surprised. There were two classes in Zhan Fei's department. In the ordinary class, there were more than 50 people in the two classes and only about 20 people attended the class. However, the black face class was always full. Even if there were a few new faces, no one would be surprised. They were found by someone as a substitute.

At this moment, the prime seats in the classroom, the last few rows, were already occupied by people, so Zhan Fei and Zhou Tai had no choice but to sit in the front seats. After Zhan Fei and others sat down, other students in the department also arrived one after another.

Some of the more studious students occupied the front row, and the seats in the middle were gradually filled. The classroom, which originally had an absence rate of 60%, was almost full. And when the class was about to begin, three girls arrived late, and many people in the class looked secretly at the three girls who had just entered the classroom.

The person at the head of the three men wore a black and red short-sleeved shirt, exposing his snow-white arms, and denim shorts on his lower body. His long and slender legs were exposed to the air. He had medium-long and capable hair, exquisite facial features, and big eyes. He was holding a book on analytical geometry in his hand and holding a lollipop in his mouth. He looked like a character that jumped out of a comic.

This person is none other than Han Ling, the beauty of Zhan Fei and others' department. Behind Han Ling are her two good sisters, Wang Xuefei, who looks weak and weak, and I feel sorry for her, and Xu Jiaorong, who is plump but has a hint of wealth. In terms of appearance, Wang Xuefei is no worse than Han Ling.

However, because of her introverted personality, Wang Xuefei's popularity in the class was slightly lower than that of Han Ling. When the three girls saw the class full of people, there was a hint of surprise in their eyes. Then, Xu Jiaorong seemed to remember something and whispered: "Today is the black face class, and those less common guys are here too."

Xu Jiaorong said and glanced at Zhan Fei and the other group of people. At this moment, there were relatively few seats in the classroom. The three of them took a look around. Xu Jiaorong and Wang Xuefei had no choice but to sit on the side of Lu Feng and his girlfriend. Lu Feng and his girlfriend sat in four rows of seats.

But most people didn't want to be light bulbs, of course, more because they didn't want to make themselves more envious and jealous, so they didn't bother them. Xu Jiaorong and the others had no seats, so they sat over, while the remaining Han Ling also sat on the side of Zhan Fei generously.

Although there are several other empty seats in the classroom, these empty seats are all inside. Only Zhan Fei and three other people are sitting against the wall, so the empty seats are outside. Watching Han Ling sit on one side of him, Zhan Fei's heartbeat changed slightly before he recovered.
